reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone; Apollo DN3500; Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01
user_report: After releasing with AltGr and leaving the host pointer outside MAME, activating the guest display still captures the mouse.

correlated_existing_evidence.R161: A left click delivered to a focused MAME window while released recaptures and is consumed; AltGr releases it.
correlated_existing_evidence.R160_R188: A bounded keyboard wake restores the guest display while capture remains released.
correlated_existing_evidence.R173: XTest motion, focus activation and an XTest click during black-screen wake did not reproduce capture; this is not a physical-device reproduction.
correlated_existing_evidence.R196: Window activation without click or pointer movement did not change the Lua hook; SDL grab was not directly queried.

result: The report is current, but this turn performed no physical wake event. The read-only hook state is released. Existing evidence narrows the known path to click-to-capture but does not prove that it caused the reported post-AltGr activation capture.
limits: The precise physical wake gesture (mouse motion, click, or keyboard) remains unrecorded.
The Lua capture flag does not directly expose SDL's host pointer grab.
No hook, MAME setting, VM profile, guest file, or original VM was changed.
next: Keep the hook unchanged. Correlate the actual post-AltGr wake gesture with host focus, pointer position, Lua capture/options and SDL grab before altering capture semantics; continue the independent authorized GTK2 work meanwhile.
